messages:
Grace H: Posted a concise postmortem for the metering variance from 2026-04-20..21. Looks like delayed consumer checkpoints caused partial drops. Need concrete owners for backfill, invoice fixes, and a preventative cadence. https://redwood.internal/pm/MP-2026-variance
Omar D: Skimming now. Any ballpark on affected accounts / dollars?
Felix Z: Initial ledger scan: ~73 accounts impacted, ~1.9M tokens. I'll take ingestion fix + orchestrated backfill. Plan: patch consumer, run staging dry-run, then prod backfill. Expect CSV of deltas by 2026-05-03 EOD. Risk: archived shard replay may take extra day.
Nina Q: I'll own invoice remediation and customer comms. Need CSV cols: account_id, period_start, period_end, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, token_delta, suggested_credit_usd, notes. Also want a top-10 diff snippet for sanity checks.
Priyanka (acct): Accounting: set thresholds: credits > $300 require manager sign-off; > $2,000 require finance+legal. Add ledger memo for audit with JIRA id.
billing-bot: JIRA-5380 created: "Metering variance 2026-04-20..21". Labels: billing, backfill, monitoring. Priority: P2.
Grace H: Action items (owners + due dates):
- Consumer patch + staging dry-run -> Felix Z -> due 2026-04-29
- Prod backfill + deltas CSV upload -> Felix Z -> due 2026-05-03 EOD
- Invoice corrections + segmented comms -> Nina Q -> draft by 2026-05-05, send after accounting sign-off
- Accounting sign-off & audit memo -> Priyanka (acct) -> sign-off by 2026-05-06
- Monitoring rule + weekly sweep for 6 weeks -> Omar D -> PR by 2026-04-28
Omar D: I'll open the monitoring PR today. Proposed alerts: late_event_rate > 500/5m OR backfill_delta_percent > 0.15% triggers a runbook. Also adding a scheduled weekly ingestion-lag report for 6 weeks post-fix.
Felix Z: Validation query (staging):
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as corrected_tokens
FROM metering_events_backfilled
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-04-20' AND '2026-04-21'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
Will attach CSV + top-10 diff and an md5 checksum to JIRA-5380.
Nina Q: For comms: three tiers: automated small-credit note (<$75), templated notice ($75-$300), and personalized outreach (>$300). Will draft templates and a short FAQ paragraph explaining cause and credit calc by 5/05.
Priyanka (acct): Please include a suggested_credit_usd column in the CSV and a memo field with JIRA link. I'll prepare accounting entries once CSV lands.
Grace H: Let's do a status check 2026-05-04 10:00 PT in #finance. If any blocker surfaces, @me and escalate to oncall. Thanks. :thumbsup:
Felix Z: Starting staging dry-run now; will post results and sample CSV excerpt to JIRA-5380 when done.
Omar D: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pull/492 includes query, thresholds, and runbook stub.
billing-bot: JIRA-5380 updated: staging dry-run completed, sample CSV uploaded.
Priyanka (acct): Received sample CSV. Accounting computing suggested credits now; will circle back with thresholds for manual review.
Nina Q: Thanks. Once I have the final CSV, I'll stitch invoices and schedule the customer sends.
